themes_detail.label: Street Lights Failing Across District
themes_detail.summary: Street light outages have spiked to 32 complaints 3 weeks ago—a 412% increase over the 8-week baseline of 6.2 weekly complaints—suggesting a widespread infrastructure failure affecting public safety and nighttime visibility in Morningside Heights/Hamilton Heights.
evidence: 32 street light complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 6.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.89)
412% spike in Street Light Condition complaints
Sustained concern aligns with CB budget requests for DOT capital improvements
reporting_angles: Interview DOT about maintenance schedules and backlog in this district
Canvass residents on safety concerns during evening hours and impacts on foot traffic

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 8 this past week—a 106% increase over the 3.9 weekly baseline—marking a notable uptick in open-air drug problems in a neighborhood already managing significant public health and safety challenges.
evidence: 8 drug activity complaints last week vs. 3.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.54)
Converges with repeated CB budget requests for public health outreach and services
reporting_angles: Map complaint hotspots and interview NYPD about enforcement strategy
Talk to residents and local business owners about visible drug use and impacts on foot traffic

themes_detail.label: Dead and Dying Trees Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Tree health complaints surged to 3 last week—a 1100% spike from the 0.2 weekly baseline—suggesting rapid environmental degradation or a sudden reporting event that warrants investigation into park and street tree conditions across the district.
evidence: 3 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.35)
Aligns with CB requests for park and playground upgrades
reporting_angles: Check Parks Department records for recent tree assessments or disease outbreak in the district
Visit parks and green spaces to document visible tree damage or identify pattern

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints reached 3 exactly 3 weeks ago—a 500% surge from the 0.5 weekly baseline—indicating a potential contamination or quality issue affecting tap water in Morningside Heights/Hamilton Heights that warrants immediate public health review.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.0)
Coincides with broader heat/hot water crisis (2506 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Contact DEP about water testing results and any advisories issued for this district in recent weeks
Interview residents about discolored, odorous, or cloudy tap water and any health symptoms

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints reached 9 exactly 3 weeks ago—a 167% increase over the 3.4 weekly baseline—pointing to a sanitation enforcement gap or organized dumping activity in the neighborhood that intersects with broader unsanitary conditions (687 complaints over 90 days).
evidence: 9 illegal dumping complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 3.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 2.91)
Part of broader unsanitary conditions pattern (687 total complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Map dumping hotspots and interview Sanitation Department about enforcement presence and frequency
Identify likely sources (construction sites, commercial tenants) and check permit/licensing status
